checks.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_review_witness.py tests/test_review_sequential_replay.py tests/test_review_parametric_admission.py
coverage: Real protected construction/replay and existing witness check
Unchanged outputs/program errors/bad indices/blank descriptions/bad ablations rejected
Changed execution/source binding, fabricated labels and mutation during replay rejected
Nonfinite timeout rejected and existing output files preserved
Builder and checker reject an extra closing delimiter; full parse_all must yield one rule! or lambda form for each program.

feedback.request: Remove repeated hand assembly of source binding, qualified program identity, final labels and causal replay.

limits: Builder selects existing qualified cases only; arbitrary new inputs and public projections are outside this helper.
Intermediate values and causal interpretation remain authored metadata; helper executes/replays final labels, not intermediate semantics or algorithmic depth.
The synthetic qualification fixture tests wrapper integration; real CLI smoke uses retained native qualification, without rerunning qualification.
No owner acceptance, training admission, maintenance completion, ZIP build/publication, commit or push performed.
Each construction/replay phase has its own bounded timeout; default30seconds, maximum60seconds per phase.

parent_review_correction.finding: Shared wrapper can ignore trailing delimiters; helper must reject malformed program text before reference execution.
parent_review_correction.fix: Both selected and counterfactual program strings are fully parsed before protected execution/replay; exactly one rule! or lambda expression required. Shared wrapper unchanged.
parent_review_correction.reproduction: New trailing-delimiter regression failed before correction (DID NOT RAISE), then passed after strict parsing in builder and checker.

scope: Optional standalone reviewer witness template/build/check helper using existing native qualification binding/schema checks and protected replay. No qualification or admission gate changed.
